sites.source: recreation.gov catalog for 273352 (75 records: 23 bookable STANDARD ELECTRIC for RV + 1 tent-only electric + 1 '45-Management'; 49 STANDARD NONELECTRIC for RV, 16 reservable and 33 not; 1 group; 'Driveway Entry' Back-In on all; 'Driveway Length' 24/35/40), read 2026-10-30

values.note: Hot showers, boat ramp, firewood sold, camp hosts. The lake's swim beach and boating are across the road.

facilities.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/273352 ('The restroom facilities include hot water showers', 'the campground features a boat ramp and dump station', 'Firewood can be purchased', 'Across the road, the lake offers ... swimming, boating, fishing'), read 2026-10-30

booking.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/273352 (notice 'First-come, first-served sites are also available'; rules reservationCutOff 2, minHolidayWeekendStay 3; 14-day limit notice) + catalog reservable flags, read 2026-10-30

note: USFS Chattahoochee NF (Chattooga River RD), run by FIND Outdoors. Two loops in the hills above Lake Rabun, across the road from the lake's beach. When towing, rec.gov's directions advise the route via US 76, Charlie Mountain Rd, Bridge Creek Rd and Burton Dam Rd. --Claude
summary: Confirmed on recreation.gov: $30 non-electric / $40 water+electric (2026 and 2027), showers, dump, Apr 1-Oct 30 season, mixed reservable/FCFS. Changed electric 50 -> 30 (catalog: every electric site 30 A); sites 80 -> 72 public RV sites (all back-in, driveways 24-40 ft, so all fit 23 ft); added max rig 40, season dates, booking URL/note. Pin ~160 m from the site coordinates, fine. Across the road from the lake: not waterfront consistent.
flags: ELECTRIC corrected 50 -> 30: every bookable electric site in the RIDB catalog lists 'Electricity Hookup' 30.

SITE COUNT 80 -> 72: recreation.gov's description says 80 campsites, but its catalog has 75 records: 72 public RV sites (23 electric, 49 non-electric), one tent-only electric site, one management site and the group site. Every RV site's driveway is 24 ft or more.
FS PAGE stale: still shows 'Seasons of Use 04/13/2025 - 10/31/2025' and 'Will Reopen from April 13 to October 30 for the 2025 season'; recreation.gov's 2026-2028 seasons run April 1 to October 30.
